issues.problem: gr-short explain claimed most compounds keep the first two morae of each part, but コンビニ (front only) and パソコン (パーソ → パソ) do not follow it; applied mechanically it gives wrong forms
issues.action: Rewrote: split into two-of-each-part (リモコン, エアコン, スマホ, パソコン with long vowel dropped) and front-only (コンビニ, デパート, アプリ, アニメ); stated that the pattern must be learned per word

issues.problem: gr-short tip ('take two sounds from each part') produces wrong words for コンビニ and パソコン
issues.action: Replaced with a tip that does not generate forms: long katakana words usually have a short everyday form

issues.problem: gr-short mistake 学生なので…パートをしています is not really wrong, only unusual (a usage tendency, not an error)
issues.action: Removed the entry; the バイト vs パート contrast still covers the point

issues.problem: gr-false カンニング example has no subject, so the Japanese defaults to 'I', but the English said 'He'
'クレーム ... never a claim for money' is too absolute (insurance trade jargon uses クレーム)
issues.action: Softened to 'not a claim for money'

issues.problem: Intro said shortened words are cut to four sounds; スマホ and アプリ have three
Mistake コンビニエンスストアで待ってるね is only stiff, not wrong
issues.action: Replaced with スマートの充電が切れそうだ → スマホ (clearly wrong)

issues.problem: Contrast glossed 二階建ての古いアパート as 'wooden', which the Japanese does not say
issues.action: Gloss changed to 'an old two-storey block of flats'
